name: decision-log-builder
description: Scans your chat channels over the last 7 days (1 to 14 if you ask, or since Monday for 'this week') for decisions made in passing and lists each one with who decided, when, the verbatim quote, the channel and a link. Questions and proposals are left out; a decision implied by agreement is marked and never pre-selected; a later decision that reverses an earlier one is linked to it; decisions already in your decision log document are marked as duplicates. After you pick the entries and approve the exact text on a card, it appends them to the end of your running decision log (or creates a new weekly log doc). It never edits or deletes existing log entries and never writes without that approval. Not a meeting-notes or task tracker.

skills.name: Decision log from chat
skills.description: Decisions made in chat in the last 7 days (1-14): decision, who decided, date, verbatim quote, channel, link, explicit or implied, duplicates of the log marked. Appended to your decision log document only after you approve the exact entries.
examples: Append them to the Team Decisions doc
